description: This file contains helper classes for streaming tests in Orleans, including client objects for consumers and producers, proxy classes for managing grain interactions, and methods for creating and controlling streaming grains within the Orleans testing framework.

classes.name: Streaming_ConsumerClientObject
classes.description: Client-side implementation of an asynchronous observer and consumer grain for streaming tests, managing subscription and message handling.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerClientObject
classes.description: Client-side implementation of a producer grain for streaming tests, capable of producing sequences and managing stream subscriptions.

classes.name: ConsumerProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing multiple consumer grains, facilitating their creation, activation, deactivation, and message consumption in streaming tests.

classes.name: ProducerProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing multiple producer grains, providing methods to produce sequences, manage lifecycle, and retrieve activation info for streaming tests.

methods.name: NewObserver
methods.description: Creates a new Streaming_ConsumerClientObject instance with specified logger and cluster client.

methods.name: NewObserver
methods.description: Creates a new Streaming_ProducerClientObject instance with specified logger and cluster client.

methods.name: NewConsumerProxy
methods.description: Initializes a new ConsumerProxy with specified stream ID, provider, target grains, logger, and grain factory.

methods.name: NewConsumerGrainsAsync
methods.description: Creates multiple consumer grains for a stream, with optional deduplication based on provided grain IDs.

methods.name: NewProducerConsumerGrainsAsync
methods.description: Creates multiple producer-consumer grains for a stream, with optional reentrant behavior.

methods.name: NewConsumerClientObjectsAsync
methods.description: Creates multiple consumer client objects for a stream, using cluster client.

methods.name: NewConsumerGrainAsync_WithoutBecomeConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer grain proxy without activating it as a consumer.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Activates the consumer grains to start consuming a specific stream.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces a sequential series of items on all target producer grains.

methods.name: ProduceParallelSeries
methods.description: Produces a parallel series of items on all target producer grains.

methods.name: ProducePeriodicSeries
methods.description: Produces items periodically on all target producer grains.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain and returns its ID.

methods.name: GetExpectedItemsProduced
methods.description: Retrieves the total expected number of items to be produced.

methods.name: GetProducerCount
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of producer grains.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops all producer grains from producing and verifies completion.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates all producer grains when idle.

methods.name: GetNumActivations
methods.description: Gets the number of grain activations for target grains.
